# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance report.
2. Pay attention to the details.
3. Look for any signs of wear and tear.
4. Look for any signs of corrosion or rust.
5. Look for any signs of structural damage.
6. Look for any signs of settling and bulging.
7. Look for any signs of water infiltration.
8. Look for any signs of debris or blockage.
9. Look for any signs of misalignment.
10. Look for any signs of paint fading or chipping.
11. Look for any signs of improper connections or joints.
12. Look for any signs of uneven pressure distribution.
13. Look for any signs of irregular vibrations or noise.
